content.comment_body: Hello everyone. I recently updated from [version_no] to [version_no] and encountered an issue. When using the 'Insert an I/O status name into the message' feature in [version_no], it was possible to leave a line blank, but now this doesn't seem possible anymore. Is this an error on my part or could this be a bug? Thank you for your assistance.
Could you provide a screenshot? If you're trying to delete a character, there may be a known issue. It's recommended to use the SPACE key for this purpose and avoid using the DEL or BACKSPACE keys.
I am unable to press the OK button now. There’s no error message, it simply does nothing.

Yes, we've observed this issue previously. Avoid using DEL or BACKSPACE for deleting characters—use SPACE instead. I've tested your scenario and can confirm it works if you use SPACE to erase content. For clarity, could you share which Windows version, Windows language settings, and what language is set in [product_name]?
I've run a quick test program and experienced the same result.

This matches the problem we've seen before. Your current version doesn't show the same symptoms, but I was able to replicate the issue with my setup. My configuration uses a single language and a US keyboard. I suspect this may be part of the problem.
That solved it—thank you. I'm working with VMWare [version_no], Windows 7 Professional, Danish language for Windows, and English for [product_name].
Thanks for sharing your details. Hopefully, someone on the development team notices this issue, unless a support ticket is submitted to inform them directly.
Meanwhile, the new versions of the software and hardware have introduced enough issues that it seems even the development engineers are affected by the same problems seen in [product_name].
I’ve had the same experience—using a Spanish keyboard with Windows 7 Professional. I also used the SPACE key by chance to delete content.

analysis.insight_summary: Users observed a difference between [version_no] releases of [product_name] regarding message text editing, particularly the inability to leave I/O status lines blank as before. Deleting content now requires using the SPACE key instead of DEL or BACKSPACE, which is unintuitive and undocumented. This led to user confusion and problems interacting with the interface.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to freely leave lines empty or delete characters in message texts within [product_name] using DEL or BACKSPACE, as previously possible, and not have to rely on unconventional workarounds like using the SPACE key.
